description: Open-source framework for building multi-agent AI applications with tool use and state management

justification.D_rationale: D=2: Agent pipelines typically access multiple data sources (vector stores, APIs, databases, web) with varying control levels depending on the deployment.
justification.T_rationale: T=2: The agent orchestration code (LangChain/LangGraph) is open source and fully visible. The underlying LLMs powering the agents are typically opaque vendor APIs.
justification.A_rationale: A=2: LangGraph agents autonomously plan multi-step workflows, use tools, maintain state across interactions, and make routing decisions.

edge_case_notes: LangChain itself is a framework, not a deployed system. This classification applies to a typical production deployment using LangGraph agents with tool use. Simple LangChain chains without agent autonomy could be Tier B.
